_about: cc-P155: the web console's links hub, besides the Shard Console's own websites (scripts/websites.json, checked by the status collector) and both GitHub repos (read from git). Each is checked by web-console/server.py every 60 s: any HTTP answer is up (a redirect or a 401 is a site answering); a refused connection or a timeout is down. A self-signed certificate is accepted for the check only. No token, key or password ever goes in this file.
